main_text.head: Technolo gia Kecke manni.
main_text.p: lium non oporteat intelligere militarem ducis, aut fabrilem architecti, aliásve hujusmodi, quæ artificis manu non exercentur. Possunt enim hæ ad liberales artes, aut etiam ad superiores scientias utcunq; revocari, ut architectura ad Geometriam, & ars ducendi exercitum ad Politicam.

Atq; hæc est sententia Fonseca, qui 1. Artis vocabulum latè sumit. 2. Dialecticam in actiuis, non effectivis ponit. 3. Theologiam facit scientiam: quum ea sit habitus mixtus, & aliquod collectivum, sicuti ipsa philosophia. Id quod nos primi notavimus.
main_text.head: Cap. II. Technologia Keckermanni, & Timpleri.
main_text.p: IN Schola Peripatetica nobilis author est Keckermannus, qui partitionem philosophiæ proponit l.1.præcog.philos.cap.2. item in tabulis de modo discendi. Eam, quæ est in præcognitis, hac tabella adumbrare placet.

page.notes: The title is set in bold type across three lines. The first line is truncated at the right edge of this part, so "Technolo" is a fragment and the word continues on the other part. The second line reads "gia Kecke" and the third "manni.", with no printed hyphen visible at either break. Whether "Kecke" and "manni" form one word is uncertain from this part alone. The woodcut ornament between the paragraph and the catchword is decorative and not transcribed. The chapter numeral is printed as II (2); it is read as II. The italic "Atq;" abbreviation and the "effectivis" spelling are as printed.
